✅ طرق دفع باسمك فقط، ولا دفعات من طرف ثالث.
✅ خبرة سابقة كتاجر P2P: 100 طلب مكتمل على الأقل بنسبة إتمام 95% أو أكثر.
✅ وديعة ضمان تُحجز على المنصة بعد فتح الإيداع، حسب المستوى.
✅ الرد على الطلبات خلال 15 دقيقة في ساعات عملك المعلنة، والتزام مكتوب بقواعد مكافحة غسل الأموال.

🤝 Want to become a P2P agent in your country? Here is what is required:

✅ Full identity checks: a valid ID, a selfie, proof of address and a short video interview.
✅ Payment methods in your own name only, no third-party payments.
✅ Previous experience as a P2P trader: at least 100 completed orders at a completion rate of 95% or more.
✅ A security deposit held on the platform after deposits open, depending on the level.
✅ Replies to orders within 15 minutes during your declared working hours, and a written anti-money-laundering commitment.

📝 P2P agent applications are open now: send /p2p in a private chat with @MatrixCex_bot. Activation comes after launch and the opening of deposits, and every approval is the management's decision after review.
